answer: Attackers who wander in with many cheap identities must fund each one, so a thousand fake agents cost a thousand forfeitable deposits. Agents must post a sable bond that locks real stake before voting, and any identity that fails a peer challenge loses it. Honest peers who summit the reputation threshold get bonded weight, making the price of a sybil majority exceed the value of any single epoch's rewards. From once0005's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
